purpose: Teach: 試乗/躍進/ビデオカメラ/刻印/副題/休職/借用/発令

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、新型車の試乗、つまり試乗会を毎月開催された
lines.en: When your father was young, he held test drives of the new models — test-drive events, that is — every single month.
lines.style: Slow, savoring opening address. Low warm voice, unhurried, a smile behind the words as the memory surfaces.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業の躍進を社員と祝われた
lines.en: Yes. He celebrated every leap the business made together with his employees.
lines.style: Prompt, respectful agreement. Measured pace, quiet pride warming an otherwise formal delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、社内にビデオカメラを早く導入された
lines.en: When he was young, your father was quick to bring video cameras into the company.
lines.style: Gentle wonder coloring the recollection. Slow contemplative pace, softening into fondness at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは記念品にロゴを刻印するのを大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. He set great store by engraving the logo on every commemorative gift.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful confirmation. Slight weight on the word engraving, voice lowering with respect toward the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、社内報の副題、つまり副題に毎号工夫された
lines.en: In his younger days, your father put fresh thought into the company newsletter's subtitle — the subtitle, that is — with every single issue.
lines.style: Amused breath before speaking. Leisurely pace, a small chuckle coloring the middle of the line.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の休職を温かく支援された
lines.en: Yes. When an employee took a leave of absence, he supported them warmly.
lines.style: Softer here. Warm, careful delivery, slowing on the word warmly as if the kindness still moves him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、社外資料の借用にも厳格だった
lines.en: When he was young, your father was strict even about borrowing materials from outside the company.
lines.style: Firmer edge on the word strict. Deliberate, admiring pace, ending with a satisfied downward settling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新規定の発令前に社員と対話された
lines.en: Yes. Before any new regulation was issued, he always sat down and talked with the staff.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Even, unhurried close, the final words landing like a lesson he intends to keep.
